_comment: Routing/property registry for the Notion task sync (.claude/commands/notion-sync.md, contracts/notion-task-schema.md). All Notion ids, property names, and vocabulary strings live here so a renamed property or a new source is a one-line data edit, never a code change. Source: Albert's live Notion workspace, verified 2026-07-27.
_maintenance: Notion property/status strings are EXACT MATCH (e.g. 'Not started' lowercase s). If someone renames a property or status option in Notion, this file goes stale silently — the sync will start failing writes. Re-verify against the live schema (notion-fetch on the data_source url) whenever a write starts erroring on an unknown property/option.
_ghl_location_id_comment: Used to CONSTRUCT the url property for every created row: https://app.gohighlevel.com/v2/location/<ghl_location_id>/contacts/detail/<contactId>. Never copy item.link verbatim — message-type items link to /conversations/conversations/, not /contacts/detail/.

team._comment: Shared 'Tactical Tasks List' database, Titan Flooring HQ teamspace. Auto-write.

private._comment: Reuses Albert's existing personal 'to-do' database (under 'to-do list (personal)' page, Albert's Notion Directory > PERSONAL), filtered by its 'Private To Do' view. NOT a new database. Notes/url/Source properties were added 2026-07-27 to support this sync; Status/Priority/tags/Assignee/Due Date/Task already existed and are unchanged. Approval-gated: the sync must always propose-and-stop for this destination, never auto-write.

project_status_meeting_processor._comment: Registry for .claude/skills/project-status-meeting-processor. All Notion database/collection ids, template ids, and property names that skill uses live here, never hardcoded in SKILL.md or its references/ files. Source: titan_context.md uploaded by Albert 2026-09-02.
project_status_meeting_processor._write_policy_note: This skill's Notion writes are 'auto' (task/CII creation and note-appends happen without a per-item approval prompt) per Albert's explicit direction 2026-09-02, and are logged to the day's actions-log.json for audit, same as the notion-sync command's auto destination. Unlike notion-sync's GHL-sourced candidates, an owner/due-date named here comes from an explicit spoken assignment in a meeting Albert runs, not an inference — see SKILL.md's 'Setting Assign To / Due Date' note for the narrower rule that still applies (unambiguous + explicitly stated only).

project_status_meetings._template_note: Template instantiation overrides the properties block passed at creation — always re-apply Name of Meeting + Date of Meeting via update_properties immediately after create.

tactical_tasks._comment: Same underlying database as destinations.team above (the shared Tactical Tasks List) — property names for title/status/priority/etc. are that same schema. This skill additionally uses two relation properties notion-sync.md does not touch — verified live against an existing row (notion-fetch on 'Verify flooring from Orlando', 2026-09-02) after the uploaded titan_context.md's names (Tactical Associated / Project) turned out wrong for this side of the relation.
tactical_tasks._relation_naming_note: Notion names each side of a two-way relation independently. On the Project Status Meetings page, the reverse-relation listing its linked tasks is 'Tactical Associated' (unverified, inherited from titan_context.md) — but on the Tactical Task's own page, the property pointing back to its meeting is 'Project Status' (confirmed live), and the property pointing to Titan Projects is 'Projects', plural (confirmed live), not 'Project'.

cii._never_link_to_meeting: Per Albert's directive: never populate the Project Status Meetings relation on a CII at creation or on append, even though the property exists. CIIs are scoped above any single meeting.

titan_projects._comment: Master project list. Query by client name; bias toward projects from the last 60 days for match accuracy. Read-only for this skill — never created or modified.

project_financials._comment: Row titles: PP-XXX_ClientName | City (Financials). Search client name + 'Financials', not PP-ID alone. Read-only for this skill.

source_defaults._comment: Default destination per ingest source. A new *-ingest source needs only one line here — no writer code change. An item's own `sensitivity` field (contracts/ingest-schema.md) may escalate team -> private, never the reverse. This table also feeds vault-writer-agent's `visibility` mapping (team -> staff, private -> admin — see the Visibility section of titan-vault CONVENTIONS.md); an unknown source reads as private/admin. `notion` is team because the five ingested databases are staff-shared tables; admin-grade sub-sources (e.g. Project Financials, if ever ingested) are escalated per-item at ingest via notion-ingest-sources.json.

people._comment: Reference registry of human identities across platforms — Notion person IDs behind the Tactical Tasks List per-person views, and (as of 2026-08-09) GHL user IDs for the ghl_owner: reference line in Notes (contracts/notion-task-schema.md). The sync NEVER sets Assign To and never auto-routes off ghl_user_id (contracts/notion-task-schema.md rule 4) — this table exists for reference/reporting only, not for the sync to assign into.
people._ghl_user_id_comment: There is no MCP tool that resolves a GHL user ID to a name (confirmed 2026-08-09 against the live account's full tool catalog and a direct /users/ pull) — this is a hand-maintained mapping of GHL's entire 5-user roster. Re-verify if Titan's GHL user list changes; a `ghl_owner: unmapped (<id>)` line in a synced task's Notes is the signal that a new ID needs adding here.

mark_bot.name: Mark Bot
mark_bot._note: GHL-only automation/bot account, not a staff member — no Notion person mapped. Kept here so its ID resolves to a label instead of showing as unmapped.
